description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Eththukala, Negambo D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 511423 (24/0528)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration and determinations under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, cadastral map references, locations, and ownership details (all showing "The State" as owner). The content falls under "Land registrations, property ownership, land titles" as defined in Type 4 (Land Gazettes) and is published in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette.
